trend.basis: total is the seven channels covers_gen renders (web, gr, ot, walk, recep, ota, tp). The 'other' channel is excluded from the page and from this series, so it ties exactly to the headline card. Per-week 'other' covers: W36 4, W39 2, W40 12, W41 3, W43 3, nil elsewhere.

tag_diagnostic.method: GA4 create-path bookings divided by SevenRooms website booking ROWS, same Mon-Sun week, per venue. SevenRooms is independent of anything on our own site. GA4-internal funnel ratios are not used.
tag_diagnostic.denominator_caveat: The current-week denominator has not settled. Recomputing W42 a week on returned website covers 5 to 9 per cent lower than published, so settled-equivalent ratios are about 1.53, 1.09 and 1.04.
tag_diagnostic.verdict: Collection ran on all seven days at all three properties, so the tag is clean for a full week. Aqua NYC and Hutong NYC sit within their pre-break norms on a settled-equivalent basis. Hutong Miami is below its norm for a second week and wants rechecking.

BOUNDARY CHANGE, staff versus other. The strict London regex leaves single-word and all-lowercase host names outside the seven channels, which would put 161 covers into 'other' in the recomputed prior week (Luz 68, andrew sicklin 50, Tracey 28, Lucilly 8, Gaby 5, Mariana 2). Last week's published 'other' was 7, so the prior run excluded those by some means it did not record. A mechanical name-shape rule is used here instead: after every explicit channel and partner literal is tested, any remaining value made only of letters, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens and full stops is read as staff, except the campaign tags Google, Facebook, Instagram and Email. Effect against last week's published basis: 'other' falls from 7 to 0 in the recomputed prior week, so 7 covers leave the all-channel total. 'Facebook' remains in 'other' (3 covers at Aqua Roma this week).

BULK IMPORT, MECHANICAL RULE, SEVENTH CONSECUTIVE WEEK AT HUTONG NEW YORK. Any booking whose service date falls before the Monday of the week it was created in is dropped, no threshold and no per-burst judgement. This week it removed 66 records / 178 covers, all OT Guestcenter at Hutong New York, service dates 5 Mar 2026 to 25 Oct 2026, created between 26 Oct 15:00 and 31 Oct 16:00 America/New_York. The deepest single hour, 26 Oct 15:00, held 61 past-dated records / 167 covers. Nothing removed at Aqua Roma, Aqua Kyoto NYC or Hutong Miami.

FORWARD-DATED LOAD NOT CAUGHT BY THE RULE, and material. All 125 OT Guestcenter records / 390 covers kept at Hutong New York this week were created in just four hours (26 Oct 15:00 n=38, 29 Oct 18:00 n=36, 31 Oct 16:00 n=34, 27 Oct 14:00 n=17). The rule keeps them because their service dates are forward of their creation week, which is the known failure mode from w2026-10-05. Hutong New York's OpenTable week-on-week move of 413 to 649 is therefore not readable as demand. No other venue has an hour with 12 or more records in a single source.
